q-11491: Correct answer: B. After one bulb burns out, the load on the circuit changes and the flasher begins to flash clearly faster — a fault signal for the driver. The other indicators keep working, and the failed bulb should be replaced immediately.
q-2635: Correct answer: A. Every car of the set must have its own fire extinguisher in an easily accessible place, because a fire can start in any car and passing between them is sometimes impossible. One extinguisher for the whole set does not meet this requirement.
q-3943: Correct answer: C. A shoe brake works through friction of the linings on the drum; when the linings are worn, the clamping force is not enough and the vehicle rolls on despite the brake being applied. Such a tram must be withdrawn from service and the fault reported.
q-4066: Correct answer: A. A tram is not registered like a car and carries no number plate, but it must have a visible fleet number identifying the car. A logo or the city's name is not required, though operators often display them.
q-4108: Correct answer: C. A tram is an electric vehicle in which the installation remains live, so it is extinguished with an agent that does not conduct electricity: carbon dioxide or powder. Water and foam conduct electricity and risk electric shock and destruction of the equipment.
q-4110: Correct answer: C. Hazard lights warn other road users that the vehicle is standing in a place where it creates a hazard, for example after a breakdown. They are not for saying thank you or for signalling an ordinary stop at a tram stop.
q-4136: Correct answer: B. The interior mirror serves to watch the door zone: the driver must see whether the exchange of passengers is complete and whether anyone has been caught in the doors. The car's outline is watched with the exterior mirrors.
q-4144: Correct answer: B. The service brake serves for everyday reduction of speed and stopping of the car, so every tram going out on the line must have one. The emergency and parking brakes perform other tasks and do not replace it.
q-4169: Correct answer: B. The exterior mirror should show the side of the car and the space behind it — only then does the driver see the door zone and vehicles approaching along the carriageway. Folding the mirror deprives them of that view and is not permitted.
q-4614: Correct answer: A. A moped rider must always wear a protective helmet, regardless of speed and the length of the route; the duty also covers a passenger being carried. The helmet must be fastened correctly, otherwise it does not do its job.
